prompts.text:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Draw THREE NEW COMPLETE PRODUCTION ANIMATION KEY POSES of this exact level2 mushroom nursery. Start fresh from this approved reference, not cutout parts. One horizontal strip of3 equal square cells, true transparent RGBA background, generous clean gutters. Each complete nest has the same original camera, palette, painterly rendering, fine dark green outline, ivory cradle design and exactly3 coral eggs. Draw every visible surface coherently, with ONE clean contour and intact connections. No collage, cutout warps, fragments, scratches, doubled edges, motion trails, holes, background, labels or particles.
LOCK the original ivory cradle and eggs at the SAME SIZE, SAME contours and ground position in ALL3 cells. No growth in this strip. Same square-cell coordinate system: groundx256,y448, original cradle width310/512. Same lighting and source proportions. Do not zoom each object to fill its cell.
LEFT: about HALF CLOSING. The same salmon cap lowers and its outer edges curl DOWN around the front and sides. The central front lip reaches roughlyy330/512 rather than the originaly260. Stem compresses naturally and remains joined to the cap. Egg tops begin to be hidden; lower cradle remains the exact reference.
MIDDLE: deeply closing, about80percent down. The SAME cap extends into a long smooth protective bell-shaped hood. Its front hem reachesy405 and side hems droop around both sides of the cradle. Eggs and neck are almost completely concealed. The cap is still one thick organic mushroom surface, with maroon lining only inside curled hems. No sideways flared horizontal wings, no new white ball under the hood.
RIGHT: FULLY DEEPLY CLOSED SMALL level2 pose. Cap front and side hems reachy430-437 while the ground remainsy448. The long coral hood wraps the original nest almost to the bottom, with only a THIN low crescent of the original ivory base showing. All eggs and neck hidden INSIDE. The cap has not grown, the cradle has not shrunk; it is physically covered by the same downward-draped mushroom cap. Preserve rounded volume and a single continuous smooth surface; do not turn it into fabric, tentacles, fingers or a separate cover.
These are actual source drawings for a hand-drawn game animation and must be clean standalone complete objects. All three drawings must maintain exact identity and body scale, never crop the silhouette, and have genuinely transparent negative space.

EDIT this exact3-cell production sheet. Its positions and object sizes are LOCKED. Preserve the original ivory cradle pixels, size, folds and ground position in ALL3 cells. Do not enlarge the objects to fill their cells, do not change lower-body anatomy. Each512px square cell uses the same groundx256,y448. Keep exact original rendering, palette, line quality and light. Draw whole coherent poses, no cutout or warped fragments. Genuine transparent RGBA background.
Only change the mushroom CAP and compress the connected stem as it lowers. LEFT CELL: halfway down, front cap lip abouty335, egg tops partly covered, same cradle unchanged. MIDDLE CELL: cap becomes a LONG downward-draped bell-shaped hood, front hem abouty405, all3eggs and stem fully hidden, original lower ivory rim still visible. RIGHT CELL: cap is fully deeply draped around the FRONT AND BOTH SIDES, its hems reachy432-437, nearly the y448 ground. Cover at least85percent of the cradle; only a VERY THIN ivory bottom crescent remains visible. The same long coral hood wraps around and physically occludes the unchanged cradle. NO broad ivory basket showing in right cell, no horizontal wing edges high above the base. Side skirts must turn DOWN, joining the low front hem. No white dome or ball beneath the hood. No cloth seams or extra lobes. One intact thick organic mushroom canopy, burgundy lining only inside curled hems.
ALL3 bodies are identical SMALL LEVEL2 size, no growth yet. No labels, words, grid lines, floor, shadow, glow, particles, scratches, loose pixels or fragments. The result is three actual complete source keyframes, not a plan or collage.

Draw TWO complete production keyframes by EDITING image1's2-cell layout. Image1 is the exact camera, canvas registration and SMALL/ADULT design authority. Image2 is ONLY the pose reference: use its RIGHTMOST long deeply closed hood posture. Keep image1's generous margins and groundx256,y448 within each512px square cell; do NOT zoom to fill a cell. Preserve the original palette, painterly style, thin dark green outline and light.
LEFT CELL = MEDIUM CLOSED size, the first quantum growth step. Cradle width325px, main cap width418px, cap apex near y140. It is naturally between the approved small and adult dimensions, not a different design.
RIGHT CELL = FULL ADULT CLOSED size, second growth step. Keep the EXACT level3 ivory cradle size and original fold design from image1's right cell, width334px; main canopy width436px, apex near y120. Do NOT enlarge this adult cradle beyond the reference.
In BOTH cells the same salmon mushroom cap is STILL FULLY DOWN, with a LONG smooth downward drape around the FRONT AND BOTH SIDES. The front and side hems reachy432-437, nearly the y448 cradle bottom. Cover at least85percent of the cradle: only a VERY THIN ivory bottom crescent shows. Do not lift the hood or reveal any neck, eggs or machinery during growth. The three eggs and adult wood collar, vents and bellows are sheltered INSIDE the intact closed canopy, no device poking through the sides. The canopy is one continuous thick organic mushroom surface with little burgundy lining in inward-curled hems, not cloth or separate panels. No added lobes, tentacles, small mushrooms or white domes.
Draw each ENTIRE pose cleanly from scratch as one coherent finished object, not a collage or cutout deformation. No cracks, slices, doubled outlines, floating fragments, scratches, residual pixels or cutoffs. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no floor, cast shadows, text, labels, particles or effects. These two full drawings will be the actual held growth-stage source keyframes.

Local correction to BOTH complete mushroom keyframes in this2-cell strip. Keep their exact canvas, positions, relative medium/adult sizes, cap crowns, widths, original ivory cradle dimensions and original painterly art. The same cap must envelop the nest MUCH MORE DEEPLY. Currently too much ivory basket shows, especially at both sides. Extend the lower coral surface down around the FRONT and BOTH SIDES, so the long drooping side skirts join a low front hem almost at the ground. The front hem AND side hems should reach abouty432-437/512, leaving only a VERY THIN10-18px high ivory crescent at the bottomy448. The side edges must turn DOWN around the basket, not flare horizontally high above it. Do NOT shrink, remove or redesign the ivory cradle to fake coverage: actually cover it with the lengthened SAME continuous coral mushroom canopy. Hide all upper ivory folds, leaving ONLY the original lowest base outline. One intact soft organic bell-shaped mushroom hood, no separate panels, seams or added lobes. Burgundy lining only inside curled side hems. Both medium and adult remain deeply FULLY CLOSED during growth, no upward neck gap, no eggs or equipment visible. No camera changes, no overall resizing. Genuine RGBA transparent background. No loose fragments, detached outlines, residual pixels, holes, text, shadow, glow or particles.

Draw THREE NEW COMPLETE ADULT opening keyframes by EDITING image1's3-cell layout. Image1 is the EXACT approved level3 design, scale, camera, positions, palette, line quality and lighting. Image2's RIGHT cell shows ONLY the fully deeply closed hood posture to open from. All3 nests are the SAME FINAL ADULT SIZE: cradle width334/512, cap width436/512, same3eggs,2vent pods, wood collar, attached right bellows and pipe. Keep source cradle folds, egg positions and hardware proportions. No growth or camera zoom in this strip. Each512px square cell has groundx256,y448 and original margins. Genuine transparent RGBA background.

Only the low ivory cradle and lower tip of the front egg peek out. Stem, collar and both vent pods remain sheltered INSIDE the cap; do not show vent pods protruding outside the hood. If part of the right bellows is exposed, it is solid and visibly connected, with no detached parts.
MIDDLE CELL: halfway to two-thirds open. The cap front hem is abouty310 and crownneary125. Reveal all3coral eggs in the original adult cradle. The connected lower wood collar, support mounts and right bellows/pipe emerge naturally from under the canopy. Upper parts of the two vents remain covered by the drooping side hems. Newly revealed surfaces are complete finished drawings, no clipped edges or hollow missing patches.
RIGHT CELL: almost fully open, front hem abouty250 and crownneary115. Nearly the approved adult pose, but the canopy is still visibly a little lower than original. All3eggs, both attached vents, wood collar and right bellows are correctly connected and match the approved design, with only the short upper neck and top of collar partly occluded. This must be an intermediate pose leading into the exact original reference, not a redesign.
In every cell the cap is ONE continuous organic mushroom canopy that gradually unrolls and lifts, with coherent maroon underside. Avoid separate cap panels, disconnected wings, cutout/rig artifacts, straight sliced boundaries, doubled outlines, fragments, residue, scratches, extra mushrooms, white balls, rubbery machinery, floating vents or pipes. Draw each ENTIRE nest as one clean coherent production cel. No text, labels, grid, floor, cast shadow, glow or particles.

Correct ONLY the cap poses in this3-cell strip of COMPLETE adult mushroom nests. Preserve all visible cradle, egg and mechanism artwork, original adult size, ground, canvas and spacing. The opening poses are currently TOO FAR OPEN and do not give enough bridge drawings from the deeply closed hood.
LEFT: keep a much LONGER low coral hood, front hem at abouty380/512, side hems down around the cradle. Only the bottom portion of the front egg peeks out; other eggs, neck, collar and vents remain naturally occluded, not erased. The right bellows can peek out attached at the side. Crown apex at abouty130/512. This is just beginning to lift from a deeply wrapped posture.
MIDDLE: lower the cap's front hem to abouty310/512, so the top of collar and most vent pods are still sheltered. Three eggs and lower attached hardware visible. Crown at abouty120/512.
RIGHT: cap front hem abouty250/512, still lower than the final fully open reference, leaving the short upper neck partly hidden. Three eggs and the2complete attached vents and bellows visible in their exact approved positions. Crown at abouty115/512.
Draw the long, unrolling cap surfaces naturally between crown and hem; do not simply translate the entire cap or scale the nest. ALL3 have the same physical adult size. The crown should rise gradually left-to-right, while the hem clearly rises in three stages. One continuous organic cap with correct maroon underside and smooth intact curled edges, no tentacles, extra lobes, cutouts, collage boundaries, transparent holes in solid material or floating fragments. All occlusion must be physically coherent, with machinery visibly connected whenever revealed. Genuine RGBA transparent background; no text, labels, shadows, particles, glow or residual specks.

Draw ONE NEW WHOLE production keyframe at the EXACT MIDDLE growth size between these two closed mushroom nests. Image1 is the SMALL fully closed pose, image2 the LARGE fully closed pose. Same square canvas and ground/rootx256,y448/512. Do not zoom or recenter. Keep the same long deeply draped bell-shaped canopy posture, same lighting, original salmon/maroon/ivory palette, thin dark green outline and painterly rendering.
The new middle canopy must be VISIBLY TALLER AND WIDER than image1, yet smaller than image2. Target normalized512px dimensions: maximum cap width about432px (between small398 and large466), crown apex aroundy160 (between small172 and large146), ground remainsy448. Preserve the same tall rounded hood proportions, NOT a flatter or shorter cap. Draw natural intermediate volume, not a camera zoom.
The cap remains fully lowered around the front AND both sides, with hems near y434-437 and only a very thin ivory base crescent visible at the bottom. Exactly the same original nursery is hidden inside; no eggs, neck, vents, collar or bellows visible, no upper ivory folds. One continuous intact organic mushroom cap with smooth downward skirts and burgundy lining only in curled side hems. Same complete coherent object, no cutout assembly, no warped strips, double edges, holes, residue, disconnected bits, faces, tentacles, added lobes or extra mushrooms. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no labels, effects or ground shadow. This drawing will be used directly as the FIRST instantaneous growth stage and held still.
